name: Phase 2B — POC Lead Acquisition & Ranking (Error Handled)

parameters.jsCode:
// Keep only the columns that exist in ranked_pocs table
return items.map(i => ({
  json: {
    poc_id:                   i.json.poc_id  || null,
    company_uid:              i.json.company_uid,
    lead_rank:                i.json.lead_rank,
    match_type:               i.json.match_type,
    partner_confidence_score: i.json.partner_confidence_score,
    selection_reason:         i.json.selection_reason,
    score_email:              i.json.score_email,
    score_poc_match:          i.json.score_poc_match,
    score_hr_fallback:        i.json.score_hr_fallback,
    score_seniority:          i.json.score_seniority,
    score_linkedin_bonus:     i.json.score_linkedin_bonus,
    total_leads_found:        i.json.total_leads_found,
    first_name:               i.json.first_name,
    last_name:                i.json.last_name,
    full_name:                i.json.full_name,
    job_title:                i.json.job_title,
    selected_email:           i.json.selected_email,
    email_type:               i.json.email_type,
    email:                    i.json.email,
    personal_email:           i.json.personal_email,
    mobile_number:            i.json.mobile_number,
    linkedin:                 i.json.linkedin,
    company_name:             i.json.company_name,
    company_domain:           i.json.company_domain,
    industry:                 i.json.industry,
    run_id:                   i.json.run_id  || null
  }
}));

// Keep only columns that exist in unidentified_poc_leads table.
// These leads have valid person data but no company_uid linkage.
return items.map(i => ({
  json: {
    first_name:       i.json.first_name       || '',
    last_name:        i.json.last_name        || '',
    full_name:        i.json.full_name        || '',
    job_title:        i.json.job_title        || '',
    headline:         i.json.headline         || '',
    seniority_level:  i.json.seniority_level  || '',
    email:            i.json.email            || '',
    personal_email:   i.json.personal_email   || '',
    mobile_number:    i.json.mobile_number    || '',
    linkedin:         i.json.linkedin         || '',
    city:             i.json.city             || '',
    state:            i.json.state            || '',
    country:          i.json.country          || '',
    inferred_domain:  i.json.inferred_domain  || '',
    searched_domain:  i.json.searched_domain  || '',
    company_size:     i.json.company_size     || null,
    industry:         i.json.industry         || '',
    run_id:           i.json.run_id           || null
  }
}));
